text:
nora (Recruiter): Heads up 026-07 panel contractors report they can see candidate email in the scorecard UI and there's no export toggle. This started after last week's ATS import. Anyone seen this?

diego (People Ops): Yikes. Which contractor accounts? We should lock exports ASAP if PII is visible.

nora (Recruiter): contractor.gamma@externals.com and contractor.delta@externals.com. They said they could copy/paste emails from the notes area. I blocked their access in the scheduler but scorecard UI is still showing.

samir (Platform Eng): I think the ATS migration accidentally changed the scorecard schema mapping: candidate.contact_email mapped into notes field instead of redacted-contact. I'll check the transform.

rachel (Hiring Manager): We had contractors in 3 interviews today. Need immediate mitigation. Can we revoke all export/print permissions for temp roles?

sean (Security): Revoke export now and start an audit. Also require immediate rotation of temp creds if any were shared.

samir (Platform Eng): Running quick mitigation: toggling export control flag on interviewer-temp role. CLI: 

```
acl update-role --name interviewer-temp --deny-export true --deny-download true
```

Applying now. This will not redact fields already rendered in the UI for users who have the page open.

access-bot: Role update queued. Operation ID: op-8852. ETA 15s.

samir (Platform Eng): Done. Exports disabled for interviewer-temp. Logging enabled for next 30 days.

sean (Security): Start manual review window: check all submissions from contractors.gamma and delta in last 24h. Flag any copy/paste activity.

diego (People Ops): I'll open a ticket to backfill redaction for affected scorecards and schedule retraining for interviewer cohort B. Ticket HR-4788 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-4788

nora (Recruiter): Thanks. For immediate interviewer access: do we want to set a shorter TTL for contractors going forward? 48h window?

rachel (Hiring Manager): 48h seems fine. Most panels are same-day or next-day. Less exposure.

samir (Platform Eng): We can enforce TTL at role creation. New default for contractor roles will be 48h. Command example to grant: 

```
rbac grant --user contractor.gamma@externals.com --role interviewer-temp --expires 2026-07-18T18:00:00Z --policy deny-export,deny-download
```

This will make export flags sticky.

sean (Security): Also add a small ephemeral token for UI sessions so if someone copies content it expires quickly; ops team can add XTTL header to responses.

diego (People Ops): Noted. For remediation: we will redact PII on the candidate notes, notify affected candidates per policy, and run a one-off audit to confirm nothing leaked. I added remediation steps in HR-4788.

nora (Recruiter): Can you also add a checkbox to the contractor onboarding flow: "I confirm I will not export or retain candidate PII"? Makes it explicit.

diego (People Ops): Yup I'll add that to the contractor NDA + onboarding checklist.

rachel (Hiring Manager): Please ping me once remediation is done so I can inform the hiring panel.

access-bot: Audit log entries created for role change op-8852 and for grants. HR-4788 updated with remediation checklist.

sean (Security): Quick note: we saw no sign of bulk export, only manual copy actions. Still treat as moderate incident and keep closure to after 30-day review.

samir (Platform Eng): Fix pushed to transformation pipeline: candidate.contact_email now maps to redacted-contact field and legacy scorecards will be backfilled. Backfill job queued HR-4788-BACKFILL.

nora (Recruiter): Great. Appreciate the quick response.

diego (People Ops): Marking thread resolved for now; keep monitoring and re-open if anything else comes up.

rachel (Hiring Manager): Thanks team.

samir (Platform Eng): Closing loop: added unit test to ETL to validate schema mapping so this won't regress.

sean (Security): Leaving monitoring rule to detect if contact_email appears in free-text candidate notes again.

diego (People Ops): Closing thread ".
